steps.descriptionEn: Each sample tube receives a unique barcode, eliminating misidentification and lost specimens.
steps.descriptionId: Setiap tabung spesimen menerima barcode unik, memastikan tidak ada sampel tertukar di laboratorium.

steps.descriptionEn: Raw test values flow directly from analyzers into the digital patient record without manual transcription.
steps.descriptionId: Setelah diproses analyzer, Diagnova menyimpan seluruh angka hasil uji secara langsung tanpa ketik ulang manual.

steps.descriptionEn: Sudden parameter shifts trigger immediate real-time alerts for pathologists and attending doctors.
steps.descriptionId: Jika terdeteksi nilai kritis atau deviasi drastis, sistem otomatis memicu peringatan seketika bagi dokter dan analis.

steps.descriptionEn: Signed reports synchronize instantly to the hospital EHR and outpatient patient portal.
steps.descriptionId: Hasil laboratorium yang telah tervalidasi langsung terkirim ke dokter dan tersinkronisasi mulus ke RME rumah sakit.

subtitle.en: Every specimen moves through a secure digital lifecycle from registration counter to clinical report.
subtitle.id: Setiap tabung spesimen bergerak melalui ekosistem digital terintegrasi dari meja registrasi hingga laporan dokter.

items.diagnovaDescEn: Automated synchronization with EHR, HIS, and SATUSEHAT without repetitive re-typing.
items.diagnovaDescId: Sinkronisasi otomatis dengan SIMRS, RME, dan terhubung resmi ke SATUSEHAT Kemenkes tanpa ketik ulang.
items.conventionalDescEn: Duplicate data entry causes specimen misidentification and slows patient onboarding.
items.conventionalDescId: Entri ganda berulang memicu salah identifikasi spesimen dan membuang waktu klinis.

items.diagnovaDescEn: Direct device interfacing and automatic verification cuts Turnaround Time (TAT) by up to 70%.
items.diagnovaDescId: Koneksi instrumen langsung dan verifikasi otomatis memangkas Turnaround Time (TAT) hingga 70%.
items.conventionalDescEn: Typing test values manually is slow and raises risk of transcript error.
items.conventionalDescId: Pengetikan angka hasil secara manual lambat dan memperbesar risiko salah transkripsi.

items.diagnovaDescEn: HL7/ASTM protocol with offline buffer keeps records safe even during network outages.
items.diagnovaDescId: Protokol HL7/ASTM dengan buffer luring (offline buffer), data tetap aman saat jaringan rumah sakit terganggu.
items.conventionalDescEn: Serial connections frequently disconnect, creating sample bottlenecks and data loss.
items.conventionalDescId: Komunikasi alat serial rentan drop, memicu antrean sampel dan risiko data hilang.

items.diagnovaDescEn: Instant critical alerts and delta checks empower physicians to respond rapidly to emergencies.
items.diagnovaDescId: Peringatan dini nilai kritis dan delta check instan, membantu dokter merespons kegawatdaruratan lebih cepat.
items.conventionalDescEn: Abnormal values go unnoticed until manual review, delaying urgent treatment.
items.conventionalDescId: Hasil abnormal lambat disadari dokter karena ketiadaan notifikasi otomatis seketika.

items.diagnovaDescEn: Every edit logs operator identity, timestamp, and previous values, ready for ISO 15189.
items.diagnovaDescId: Setiap modifikasi hasil terekam dengan timestamp, identitas operator, dan nilai sebelumnya siap akreditasi.
items.conventionalDescEn: Change history lacks cryptographic certainty, complicating accreditation audits.
items.conventionalDescId: Riwayat koreksi tidak terlacak rapi, menyulitkan akreditasi KARS dan ISO 15189.

items.diagnovaDescEn: Multi-branch scalability with automated geo-redundant backups and end-to-end encryption.
items.diagnovaDescId: Mendukung multi-cabang tanpa batas dengan backup otomatis dan enkripsi data end-to-end.
items.conventionalDescEn: Local servers are prone to hardware failure, manual backups, and rigid limits.
items.conventionalDescId: Server lokal rentan rusak fisik, backup manual jarang dilakukan, dan sulit diekspansi.
